card.summary: Unlimited asset storage on Hobby (free) with a 50 MB per-asset cap; 100 GB asset traffic/month

free_tier.stated: Unlimited asset storage on Hobby (free) with a 50 MB per-asset cap; 100 GB asset traffic/month

egress.terms: 100 GB asset traffic/month on Hobby, served from a global CDN (media.graphassets.com) with image transforms.

record.tooling: GraphQL Management API + REST asset upload endpoint, `@hygraph/management-sdk`, asset CDN URLs are public and transformable
record.chaining: Asset storage is unmetered in total capacity with a 50 MB file size cap. Bandwidth is limited to 100 GB per month on the Hobby plan.
record.limits_note: 50 MB per asset (Free/Hobby; 200 MB on Growth). 100 GB/month traffic. 2 locales, 3 seats, 10 components. Content-model limits, not storage limits. 'Unlimited' is bounded in practice by the 100 GB traffic meter, not by bytes stored.
record.reliability_note: CDN-served, no expiry; the traffic cap is the failure mode (assets stop serving at 100 GB until reset).

evidence.proved: 'Hobby $0 always ... Unlimited asset storage | 50MB per asset upload size (maximum)'; 'Asset Traffic 100 GB'
